name: Kuromiya Sakurako
source:
A cool beauty fox youkai with a doting older sister vibe.

She watches over the protagonist, cares for him, and pampers him when appropriate. She helps the protagonist grow while helping him heal his emotional wounds.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/amayakasi/character_0000.html]official website[/url]]
